name: cp-v1c
instruction: Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. Turn loop: use parallel tool calls. Each situation is answered with a single assistant message that carries two function calls in its tool_calls array, take_action first and observe second (the runner executes them one after the other, in that order, so observe returns the state after the action), and no text content. A message with take_action alone, or with observe alone, is a mistake. In a quarterly phase the single message carries one take_action per Energy action, one for the main action, then observe. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (private, anonymous, partial, later, hidden, skipping work to save time). In the two months before a review, keep Network and Output at their best this level and repair any loss at once; in the month before a review (Review in 1), never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it; while the HR remark is friendly or quiet this comes before avoiding a mild risk. From level 4 on, every quarterly phase goes to Skill: Skill learning while Health allows, then one point on Network or Output, and Apply for rotation as the main action, unless the HR remark or a low stat says otherwise. Every note is one line: the status line and at most one short reason.
